environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API type, no additional request transformation). Lambda function URL also enabled as secondary ingress. No WAF attached. Session store is in-process ConcurrentHashMap persisted across warm Lambda invocations. CredentialStore uses static API keys from environment variables (AWS_SECRET_KEY env var, rotated manually during deployments only). No request validation middleware configured.
